turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me work one example out loud before you start.
Sentence: He is ___ artist. I look at the noun: "artist". It begins with the sound "a", a vowel sound. So I use "an": He is an artist.
Rule: use "an" before a vowel sound and "a" before other sounds.
Right: He is a teacher. Wrong: He is an teacher.
Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
